name: FPC sell hook drains the pair reserve and syncs
summary: On every sell FPC's _update calls burnLpToken, which moves 65% of the sold amount out of the PancakeSwap pair and calls sync() before the swap settles, collapsing the pair's FPC reserve. The attacker flash-borrowed USDT, bought most of the pair's FPC, then sold FPC so the router priced it against a near-zero reserve.
notes: Reset is open() (0xab44056c, slot 0x7), five blocks before the anchor and its only call: every pool transfer of a non-whitelisted account reverts until startBlock is set, so it first made the exploited buy-and-sell path usable (rule 8). The token is immutable; the owner's other changes before the exploit (fee recipients, whitelists) are fee routing and do not reset the age.

The pair's USDT depletion nets the attacker's own flash-loaned buy within the transaction. The FPC that burnLpToken moved out of the pair is not valued: the same transaction destroyed FPC's only market. No other large USDT outflow from the pair followed.
